name: Re:cord Noah: Fractal of Oblivion
storyline:
Noah, a city on the sea.
Here, in this place of peace and order, beings called Sylphids use emotions as energy.
Only slightly more attuned to emotions than most, protagonist Lila crosses paths with the android 50YO-61 one day in a meeting ordained by fate.
Unbeknownst to her, that encounter will come to unseal a legacy.
summary: An upcoming otome game being developed for global release in 2026 for the Nintendo Switch. It is a collaboration between AmuLit and Soyogi Fractal, a vocal synth project made by Yuki Kaji.
